claims.sourceText: Statement for the Record, Dr. Jon Kosloski, Director AARO, SASC Emerging Threats and Capabilities Subcommittee, 19 November 2024
claims.text: Kosloski told the Senate Armed Services subcommittee on 19 November 2024 that 'to date, AARO has discovered no verifiable evidence of extraterrestrial beings, activity, or technology.'

claims.sourceText: Dr. Jon Kosloski, Statement for the Record, Senate Armed Services Committee open hearing, 19 November 2024
claims.text: 'AARO has over 1,600 UAP reports in its holdings from across the U.S. government' and 'to date, AARO has discovered no verifiable evidence of extraterrestrial beings, activity, or technology.'

claims.text: Kosloski testified on 19 November 2024 that AARO holds over 1,600 UAP reports and has discovered no verifiable evidence of extraterrestrial beings, activity, or technology.

edges.note: Kosloski was named AARO's full-time director in August 2024 and testified before the Senate Armed Services Emerging Threats and Capabilities Subcommittee on 19 November 2024.
